# Sam Whitfield — Head of Security

> Note: there are **two Sams** on Maya's leadership team. This is **Sam Whitfield, Head of
> Security**. The other is [Sam Okafor](sam-okafor.md), VP Engineering. Do not conflate them.

- **Relationship:** Maya's direct report. Owns security engineering, GRC, and compliance
  (~9-person team). Joined Novaflow in 2022 from a fintech security org.
- **Cadence:** weekly 1:1, Thursdays 10:00; incident retros as needed.
- **Owns:** [Sentinel](../projects/sentinel.md) — the SOC 2 Type II program.
- **Distinguishing fact:** a former **CISSP-certified pen-tester**; runs Novaflow's quarterly
  red-team exercise personally.

## How to work with him
- Precise and risk-driven; give him time to think, don't force snap answers on security calls.
- He'll block a launch on a real vulnerability — back him publicly when he does.
- Translate his findings into business risk for Sofia and Daniel; he's not naturally political.

## Sensitivities
- Frustrated that Sentinel evidence collection is behind because eng teams deprioritize it.
